questions.question_text: Who discovered the electron? (इलेक्ट्रॉन की खोज किसने की?)
questions.explanation: J.J. Thomson discovered the electron in 1897 through his cathode ray tube experiment, identifying it as a negatively charged subatomic particle.
questions.distractor_rationale: Rutherford discovered the nucleus. Bohr proposed planetary orbits for electrons. Chadwick discovered the neutron.

ai_context.learning_goal: Identify the scientist credited with the discovery of the electron.
ai_context.hint: Think of the scientist who proposed the 'plum pudding' or watermelon model.

questions.question_text: What was the main conclusion of Rutherford's alpha-particle scattering experiment? (रदरफोर्ड के अल्फा-कण प्रकीर्णन प्रयोग का मुख्य निष्कर्ष क्या था?)
questions.answer: Most of the space inside the atom is empty. (परमाणु के अंदर का अधिकांश भाग खाली होता है।)
options: Most of the space inside the atom is empty. (परमाणु के अंदर का अधिकांश भाग खाली होता है।)
Electrons are embedded in a positive sphere. (इलेक्ट्रॉन एक धनात्मक गोले में धंसे होते हैं।)
Neutrons are present in the nucleus. (न्यूट्रॉन नाभिक में मौजूद होते हैं।)
Electrons revolve in discrete orbits. (इलेक्ट्रॉन असतत कक्षाओं में चक्कर लगाते हैं।)
questions.explanation: Since most alpha particles passed straight through the gold foil without any deflection, Rutherford concluded that most of the space inside the atom is empty, with a tiny dense positive nucleus at the center.
questions.distractor_rationale: 'Positive sphere' is Thomson's model. 'Discrete orbits' is Bohr's model. Chadwick discovered neutrons later.

ai_context.learning_goal: Understand the findings of the gold foil experiment.
common_misconceptions: It proved electrons orbit like planets.
ai_context.hint: If you throw balls at a chain-link fence and most go straight through, what does that tell you about the fence?

questions.question_text: According to Bohr's model, what is the maximum number of electrons that can be accommodated in the M shell? (बोर के मॉडल के अनुसार, M कोश में अधिकतम कितने इलेक्ट्रॉन रह सकते हैं?)
questions.explanation: The maximum number of electrons in a shell is given by the formula 2n². For the M shell, n = 3, so 2(3)² = 2 × 9 = 18 electrons.
questions.distractor_rationale: 2 is for K shell (n=1). 8 is for L shell (n=2). 32 is for N shell (n=4).

ai_context.learning_goal: Apply the 2n² rule to calculate shell capacity.
common_misconceptions: M shell is the second shell.
ai_context.hint: Use the formula 2n². What is the value of 'n' for the M shell (K, L, M)?

questions.question_text: An atom has a mass number of 23 and an atomic number of 11. How many protons, neutrons, and electrons does it have? (एक परमाणु की द्रव्यमान संख्या 23 और परमाणु संख्या 11 है। इसमें कितने प्रोटॉन, न्यूट्रॉन और इलेक्ट्रॉन हैं?)
questions.answer: 11 protons, 12 neutrons, 11 electrons (11 प्रोटॉन, 12 न्यूट्रॉन, 11 इलेक्ट्रॉन)
options: 11 protons, 12 neutrons, 11 electrons (11 प्रोटॉन, 12 न्यूट्रॉन, 11 इलेक्ट्रॉन)
11 protons, 11 neutrons, 12 electrons (11 प्रोटॉन, 11 न्यूट्रॉन, 12 इलेक्ट्रॉन)
12 protons, 11 neutrons, 11 electrons (12 प्रोटॉन, 11 न्यूट्रॉन, 11 इलेक्ट्रॉन)
23 protons, 11 neutrons, 23 electrons (23 प्रोटॉन, 11 न्यूट्रॉन, 23 इलेक्ट्रॉन)
questions.explanation: Atomic number (Z) = number of protons = number of electrons (in a neutral atom) = 11. Mass number (A) = protons + neutrons = 23. Therefore, neutrons = A - Z = 23 - 11 = 12.
questions.distractor_rationale: Mass number is not the number of protons. The number of neutrons is the difference between mass number and atomic number, not equal to atomic number.

ai_context.learning_goal: Calculate subatomic particles from atomic and mass numbers.
common_misconceptions: Mass number equals the number of neutrons.
ai_context.hint: Atomic number = Protons. Mass number = Protons + Neutrons. What's the difference?

questions.question_text: Which of the following describes isotopes? (समस्थानिकों (Isotopes) का सही वर्णन कौन सा है?)
questions.answer: Atoms of the same element with the same atomic number but different mass numbers. (एक ही तत्व के परमाणु जिनकी परमाणु संख्या समान लेकिन द्रव्यमान संख्या भिन्न होती है।)
options: Atoms of the same element with the same atomic number but different mass numbers. (एक ही तत्व के परमाणु जिनकी परमाणु संख्या समान लेकिन द्रव्यमान संख्या भिन्न होती है।)
Atoms of different elements with the same mass number but different atomic numbers. (विभिन्न तत्वों के परमाणु जिनकी द्रव्यमान संख्या समान लेकिन परमाणु संख्या भिन्न होती है।)
Atoms with the same number of neutrons but different protons. (समान संख्या में न्यूट्रॉन वाले परमाणु लेकिन अलग-अलग प्रोटॉन।)
Atoms that have gained or lost electrons. (वे परमाणु जिन्होंने इलेक्ट्रॉन प्राप्त किए हैं या खो दिए हैं।)
questions.explanation: Isotopes are atoms of the same element, meaning they have individual same number of protons (atomic number), but they differ in the number of neutrons, leading to different mass numbers.
questions.distractor_rationale: Different elements with same mass number are isobars. Gaining/losing electrons creates ions.

ai_context.learning_goal: Define and identify the properties of isotopes.
common_misconceptions: Isotopes have different numbers of protons.
ai_context.hint: The prefix 'iso-' means 'same'. In isotopes, the element remains the same, so which subatomic particle must remain constant?
